matches.why: The factorization algorithm relies on a companion paper on primitive roots for admissible integer bases, so the family may touch Artin's primitive root conjecture.
Depends on a companion result about primitive roots for every admissible base, close to the question of infinitely many primes with a given primitive root.
Proves uniform boundedness of limit cycles of planar polynomial vector fields by degree (the second part of Hilbert's sixteenth problem) and gives the exact bound of two for quintic Liénard systems.
Constructs a smooth volume-preserving diffeomorphism of the three-torus with simple Lebesgue spectrum, answering Banach's problem in the probability-preserving setting.
